summary: Trinity shudders back into her body aboard the hovercraft after leaving the Construct, and immediately cries out for Neo. Tank, equally confused, demands to know what just happened. Trinity answers that an Agent was involved and insists that he send her back into the Matrix. Tank refuses, telling her he cannot.

what_changes.before: Disconnected and disoriented, just emerging from the Construct.
what_changes.after: Urgent and purposeful, demanding to be sent back in to reach Neo.
what_changes.evidence: Trinity blinks, shivering as her conscious exits the Construct.

what_changes.before: Confused about what just occurred inside the Matrix.
what_changes.after: Aware an Agent was involved but refusing Trinity's demand to send her back.
what_changes.evidence:
TANK
What the hell just happened?
TRINITY
An Agent!  You have to send me
back!
TANK
I can't!

event_hint.one_line: Trinity jolts back to the hovercraft and demands Tank send her back after Neo, but Tank refuses.

uncertain: Whether Trinity survived the shooting she witnessed in the previous scene.
Whether Tank's 'I can't' is a technical inability or a refusal.
